title: Low blood oxygen (SpO₂) reading
source: CrewCare team, FICTIONAL document created for the NASA Space Apps 2026 demonstration. Not from a clinical source.

approval.note: FICTIONAL PROTOCOL, NOT APPROVED. Used only to demonstrate the application workflow. Not for medical decisions.

summary: What the crew records and who it calls when SpO₂ falls below the normal band.

sections.heading: When it applies
sections.body: Rule R-LIMIT-SPO2 is active (SpO₂ below 95 %), or the crew member reports breathlessness.

sections.heading: Crew steps (fictional)
sections.body:
1. Check that the finger sensor is fitted correctly and the hand is warm.
2. Repeat the reading at rest after 2 minutes and record it.
3. Ask about breathlessness, headache or confusion and record the answers.
4. Check the cabin CO₂ reading on the Station systems page.
5. Select “Request the medical officer” if the value stays below 93 %.

sections.heading: Escalation (fictional)
sections.body: The CMO decides on any treatment using the approved mission protocol and the flight surgeon. This demo document contains no treatment instructions.
